task_prompt: Edit the supplied answer to reduce formulaic or repetitive prose. Preserve the original language, every unique claim and qualification, named terminology, numbers, quotations and citations. Do not fact-correct, add facts, imitate a human, or optimize an authorship score. Keep good text unchanged. Return an edited passage plus separate source-quality notes. Do not complete truncated answers. Exclude financial guidance accidentally admitted by the question-keyword filter; retain IDs without resampling.
generation: Current conversational assistant applied the checked-in v0.2.0 skill after reading its entry point and preservation, English, Chinese and conflict rules. Scientific passages additionally followed academic guidance. Outputs were generated in this conversation and saved verbatim as initial_revision. No external rewriting model or standalone Codex process was run.
review: Same assistant self-review; not independent, not blinded and not an A/B test. Source-quality triage followed sampling and precedes editing. All 16 selected cases remain in the record.
skill_policy: Frozen v0.2.0 runtime files; no tuning against these results. At most one targeted repair per edit; initial and final texts are kept.
metrics: Literal changes, cue-risk candidates, length changes and lint candidates are diagnostics, not fidelity or naturalness scores. Human labels are not quality gold labels.
limits: Public raw/train evaluation slice, not official HC3 paper test split.
Possible pretraining exposure; not an unseen-model benchmark.
12 ChatGPT and 4 human texts selected by deterministic hash; domain and length filters bias sampling.
Source question-keyword filter admitted two finance cases, recorded and excluded without replacement.
No commercial detector, watermark test, human editor or comparison against 32 upstream skills.
Ordinary editing preserves claims without verifying factual accuracy.
No held-out improvement estimate; no statistical significance claim.
